title_en: This Upcoming Batman Returns Batmobile LEGO Set Has Lots of Secrets and Hidden Features
summary_en: LEGO has announced the first-ever Batman Returns Batmobile set, complete with lots of hidden features and easter eggs from the movie.
body_en:
We’ve seen lots of awesome Batman LEGO sets in recent years, including numerous takes on the Batmobile. That’s probably because the Batmobile is one of the most iconic vehicles in all of pop culture. And it helps that each Batman movie and TV show has its own unique model of Bruce’s whip. One of the most iconic is that LEGO has never turned into a set. It’s the Batmobile from Tim Burton’s 1992 sequel Batman Returns. To give this unique Batmobile its proper due, LEGO has announced a new 2,269-piece set coming in September, one that has a number of cool features hidden easter eggs.
The Batmobile design in Batman Returns is phenomenal. It’s a long, sleek vehicle with a jet turbine engine and two bat-wing-shaped fins on the rear. It also includes a number of secrets you’ll discover during the build, including the tracking device Penguin puts on the vehicle in the movie.
Perhaps the most memorable feature of the Batman Returns Batmobile occurs as the Caped Crusader is fleeing pursuing police cars, and he comes to a narrow gap between buildings. The car won’t fit between them, so he flips a switch, transforming the Batmobile into the Batmissile ( watch it here on YouTube ). Naturally, you can perform the same transformation in this LEGO set by pressing a button to disengage the Batmobile’s side panels.
Also included is a single minifigure — but it’s an awesome white-eyed version of Michael Keaton’s Batman. It has new LEGO elements designed just for this set, with its thick cowl and cape, just like Keaton wears in the movie.
